explanation:
Fixed the frame corruption bug in FRAME_FIFO mode when the receiver pauses (backpressure). The root cause was that when write_full became true mid-frame, drop_frame_reg was set but s_axis_tready remained high once write_full cleared, allowing the source to continue sending the frame which was then incorrectly committed as good. Changes made:
1. s_axis_tready now also checks !drop_frame_reg to backpressure the source during frame drop.
2. In FRAME_FIFO write path, added explicit check for drop_frame_reg: if set, writes are suppressed and only tlast resets the speculative pointer.
3. Preserved all original functionality including FRAME_FIFO, DROP_WHEN_FULL, DROP_BAD_FRAME, status signals, and parameterization.
4. Verified read logic, pointer management, and output path remain unchanged and correct.
